Feature request (KC): Host templates have no Host badge in To: field
- Student comms block (admin.html ~line 4442-4446) has Student + Partner badges only
- When Host Booking / Host Availability / Host Cancel template selected, To: still shows student email
- Staff must manually delete student email and enter host email
- Token accommodation.email already resolves correctly in body (documents.ts line 863) - shortcut missing from UI only
- Example: Fanny Scelles (student 14451, bk 17843): 2 hosts: Bob + Ann OSullivan (bobosullivan5016@gmail.com) Aug 29-Oct 4, Linda Land (lindaland027@gmail.com) Oct 4-Dec 19
Add Host badge(s) to student comms To: field - derive from bookings[].accommodations[].provider.email. See recipe: issue-52-host-email-badge.md
Check if s.bookings[].accommodations[] already carries providerEmail; if not update student detail API. Optional: auto-switch To: when Host template selected.

Feature request (KC): no template covers a student with 2 accommodation periods in one email
- Token resolver (documents.ts line 499) picks ONE accommodation via pickAccommByArrival - no multi-period support
- Fanny Scelles (student 14451, bk 17843): 2 hosts - OSullivan Aug 29-Oct 4, Land Oct 4-Dec 19 (requires 2 separate emails)
- Romain Verlut (student 74, bk 80): same host Patty McSweeney, 2 periods Sep 12-Dec 19 + Jan 3-Mar 21 (split over Christmas)
Add indexed tokens accommodation_1.* / accommodation_2.* to resolveTokens(); create Host Booking (Multiple) template. See recipe: issue-53-multi-accomm-template.md
Option A (recommended): indexed tokens, low risk. Option B: loop token, more complex. Prioritise when KC confirms frequency of multi-host students.
